# `app.graycard.instance.exposure`

A single logged exposure (a shot). Works for film (references a roll + frame number) and digital (no roll). Optionally belongs to a shoot and links to a published photo by AT-URI. Everything except createdAt is optional so shots can be logged fast in the field.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/instance/exposure.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 1

## `main`

A single logged exposure (a shot). Works for film (references a roll + frame number) and digital (no roll). Optionally belongs to a shoot and links to a published photo by AT-URI. Everything except createdAt is optional so shots can be logged fast in the field.

**Kind:** `record`
**Record key:** `tid`
